prompt: Write a story about a jungler who pulls off an insane comeback as full-damage Rengar while one teammate was DC for fifteen minutes and the rest seemed doomed to feed. Start right after you respawn following a lost Baron and show how you snowball on every ult, how your team defends against three waves of super minions, and how you ultimately backdoor the second inhibitor. Make sure to bring out each teammate’s quirks, highlight the enemy comp’s late-game weaknesses, and capture the tension of pushing under the nexus turrets. The story should be roughly eight to ten thousand words long.
